title: Host API v1 — History mirror into Places (P2-T07, U-06)
description: Core owns history; the host mirrors visits into Places so :visited link styling works. The module touches Places history only (D-15: no prefs, no telemetry). Only http(s) URLs are mirrored (M-1); other schemes are acknowledged with mirrored:false.

visit.description: Mirror one core-owned visit into Places (History.insert with a default TRANSITION_LINK visit).

visit_time.description: ms since epoch (astra-store history.visit_time); omitted means now

clear.description: Mirror a core history wipe into Places (History.clear removes all visits).

isVisited.description: Read helper for tests/UI: visited state per the mirror (History.fetch). Emits no events.
